description: Core UX features: Dark mode with persistence, progress tracking in localStorage, enhanced About section with photo/social links, custom 404 page, and Cloudinary video player preparation
steps: Create src/hooks/useDarkMode.js: Hook that reads/writes 'theme' key to localStorage, defaults to 'light', returns { isDark, toggle }. Check for prefers-color-scheme on first load.

In src/styles/variables.css: Add [data-theme='dark'] selector with dark color variables: --paper: #1a1a1a, --ink: #e8e8e8, --blue: #5a8adb, --yellow: #f9d65c, --line: #333, plus adjusted shadows. Keep existing :root as light theme.
In src/components/layout/Header.jsx: Add dark mode toggle button after nav, before CTA. Use sun (☀️) for light mode, moon (🌙) for dark mode. Import and use useDarkMode hook.
In src/components/layout/Header.css: Style .theme-toggle button with circular shape, hover effects, icon sizing.
In src/App.jsx: Import useDarkMode, apply data-theme attribute to root div based on isDark state.

Create src/hooks/useProgress.js: Hook using localStorage key 'lesson-progress' storing array of viewed lesson slugs. Export markLessonViewed(slug), isLessonViewed(slug), getProgress() returning { viewed: string[], totalLessons: number }.
In src/pages/LessonPage.jsx: Import useProgress, call markLessonViewed(slug) in useEffect on mount. Show 'شوفت الدرس ده ✓' badge near lesson title if isLessonViewed returns true.
In src/components/sections/LessonCard.jsx: Import useProgress, show checkmark badge on cards where isLessonViewed(lesson.slug) is true.
In src/components/sections/LessonCard.css: Style .viewed-badge with green background, white checkmark, positioned top-right of thumbnail.

In src/components/sections/About.jsx: Add photo placeholder div (with a Python snake emoji or icon as placeholder), add social links section with YouTube, GitHub, Twitter/X links. Expand the story text to be more personal and engaging. Keep all text in Egyptian Arabic.
In src/components/sections/About.css: Add .about-photo styles (circular, border), .social-links grid with hover effects.

Create src/pages/NotFoundPage.jsx: Fun 404 page with Python theme. Include: large '404' heading, confused Python snake emoji, Egyptian Arabic message 'الصفحة دي مش موجودة يا صاحبي', animated elements with framer-motion, links to home and lessons.
Create src/pages/NotFoundPage.css: Style the 404 page with centered layout, large typography, animation-friendly structure.
In src/App.jsx: Add catch-all route <Route path='*' element={<NotFoundPage />} /> after existing routes.
In src/data/lessons.js: Add cloudinaryId field (empty string '') to each lesson object to prepare for Cloudinary integration.

Create src/components/common/VideoPlayer.jsx: Placeholder component that accepts lessonCloudinaryId and videoUrl props. For now, show the existing video-coming-soon or video-placeholder UI based on videoUrl. Add comment noting where Cloudinary SDK integration will go.
Create src/components/common/VideoPlayer.css: Responsive video player container styles, aspect-ratio 16/9.
In src/pages/LessonPage.jsx: Replace the video section JSX with the new <VideoPlayer /> component, passing lesson.cloudinaryId and lesson.videoUrl.
acceptance_criteria: Dark mode toggle appears in header and toggles theme
Theme persists across page refreshes via localStorage
All components render correctly in both light and dark modes
Progress tracking saves viewed lessons to localStorage
LessonPage shows 'شوفت الدرس ده' badge when revisiting a viewed lesson
LessonCard shows checkmark badge on viewed lessons
About section shows photo placeholder and social links
404 page displays for unknown routes with Python-themed design
VideoPlayer component renders in lesson pages
All lessons have cloudinaryId field in lessons.js
findings: All features implemented successfully. Dark mode toggle in Header with localStorage persistence. Progress tracking with useProgress hook. Enhanced About section with photo placeholder and social links. Python-themed 404 page. VideoPlayer component ready for Cloudinary integration. cloudinaryId field added to all lessons.
